config.selection: one global hyperparameter per method; equal-cell mean withheld Rician NLL; no truth used
config.no_op: first candidate for every method; earliest candidate wins exact tie
config.cubic_scale: per-user Frobenius Hankel norm / sqrt(min Hankel dimensions)
config.placement: single final shrinkage and anti-diagonal averaging after ordinary EM100
config.optshrink: Nadakuditi Algorithm 1, reduced tail dimensions n-r and m-r; see source URL
config.tie_policy: zero weight at a tail pole within 1e-13 relative squared singular-value gap, the zero-weight continuous limit
config.scope: small exploratory component diagnostic, not full LRHD, end-to-end learned comparison, or hardware model

uncertainty: exploratory paired-case bootstrap, unadjusted, conditional on the independent development selection
limitations: 72 development worlds total; 32 test worlds per cell
all methods correct EM100 only once at the end
not a matched comparison to the trained ten-stage estimator
not an LRHD reproduction or OptShrink optimality validation
global parameters selected on 21 context pilots and deployed on all 30; no test tuning
